study_note: Single-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk checkpoint bank for measuring post-hoc action-local improvement on priors trained without an inner controller. The learner is an exact 1.5-million-decision derivative of ambi_humanoid_walk_outer_prior_no_inner_d512_2_14m apart from budget and W&B identity: it samples the persistent stochastic outer policy after replay seeding, runs zero inner model steps and zero inner optimizer updates, keeps the distributional five-head AMBI critic, and explicitly retains entropy-augmented outer and inner SAC Bellman targets with learned automatic outer temperature. Separate evaluation episodes are disabled during training. Sixty portable checkpoints are retained at 25,000-decision intervals from 25,000 through 1,500,000; no step-zero checkpoint is produced. Each frozen checkpoint can later support paired outer-policy versus fresh inner-SAC evaluations without changing the learned outer state. This isolates deployment-time improvement conditional on no-inner-trained priors; it does not estimate the replay-distribution feedback of using inner improvement throughout training and remains a single-seed exploratory study.
